panel.summary: All 5 fixes sound: _store_lock spans the read-modify-write with graceful OSError fallback; kill guard converts probe-to-kill races to a clean dead outcome; lazy cold path verified via sys.modules isolation tests; bounded nudge re-probe; accurate Codex docs. Doctrine re-scope honest — bind-as-mutex retained for the daemon, store lock targeted. One LOW: intentional cold-path duplication of state-path logic. LANDABLE.

All fixes sound and correctly address the prior panel's concerns; the store lock closes the opted_in race, kill guard flows to spawn, lazy gates keep non-opted repos import-free with byte-identical output, re-probe prevents the misleading nudge, and the doctrine re-scope is an honest refinement separating data-consistency locking from the daemon's bind-based mutex. LANDABLE.

All five fixes sound with detailed mechanics verified (flock/msvcrt semantics, ensure_state_dir ordering, retry matrix, count-based lock confinement guard with split-literal self-match defense). Re-scope is more precise than the original, not weaker. One maintainability nit: triple-duplicated _watch_state_path is a drift risk worth a shared self-test in 2.26.x. LANDABLE.

All five fixes verified sound; re-scope honest — the old check conflated daemon lifecycle with store writes and would have frozen the contract in its broken state. Six LOW follow-ups for 2.26.x, scheduled first: a cross-pinning test for the triplicated state-dir/repo-key resolution (drift fails open but silently); also non-reentrant lock contract undocumented, retry window shorter than stated bind time, PermissionError labeled dead, narrower guard coverage, ~10s Windows lock stall. None make shipped behavior wrong. LANDABLE.

All five fixes sound; self-test growth matches stated counts (serve +4, engine +4, hook +2); cold-path subprocess tests defeat module caching correctly; re-probe state space fully pinned; doctrine re-scope is an honest architectural bifurcation pinned by the use-count invariant. Three LOW follow-ups: cross-pair equivalence test for duplicated resolution logic, rename the dead label for the unsignalable case, broaden the daemon-class lock grep. LANDABLE.

All fixes sound and well-tested, including correct msvcrt seek/lock-region symmetry; the re-scoped self-test honestly preserves the daemon-lifecycle invariant while preventing lock-file creep. LANDABLE.
